findings.title: Fix-rule triggers list in section order, not input order
findings.description: `recommendVersion` builds fix-rule triggers by flattening type-grouped `groups.sections`, which orders `fix`, `perf`, and `revert` commits by section rather than by their original positions. When the input stream contains `perf: b` before `fix: a`, `triggers` lists `a` before `b`; the existing fix-rule test sorts trigger types before comparing them, so it misses the discrepancy.

evidence.explanation: `groupCommits` accumulates commits by type and emits sections in a fixed order, with Bug fixes before Performance and Reverts. `recommendVersion` flattens those sections, selects the fix-rule entries, and maps them directly to triggers, so an input sequence of `perf`, `revert`, `fix` produces `fix`, `perf`, `revert` instead. The comment in `src/version.ts` acknowledges that `ReleaseGroups` does not retain global order, while ticket rule 4578699 requires winning-rule entries in input order.
